study_identification_part.si_4_title: Capturing the Individual Deviations From Normative Models of Brain Structure for Depression Diagnosis and Treatment

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Dataset II is the Human Connectome Project (HCP; 510 HC participants; age range 22-36 years). Dataset III is the REST-meta-MDD Project (229 HC participants; age range 18-65 years; site 20). Dataset I is a local clinical cohort from two hospitals (Affiliated Brain Hospital of Nanjing Medical University and Nanjing Drum Tower Hospital), consisting of 187 depressed patients and 166 HC participants, which maps to MULTI-SITE (N>=2).
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "To construct the normative models, we downloaded phenotypic data and MRI T1-weighted data from the Human Connectome Project (dataset II; 510 HC participants; age range, 22-36 years) and REST-meta-MDD Project (dataset III; 229 HC participants; age range, 18-65 years; site 20)" ... "In dataset I, we enrolled 127 depressed patients and 110 healthy control (HC) participants from the Affiliated Brain Hospital of Nanjing Medical University as the discovery cohort. Additionally, 60 patients and 56 HC participants from Nanjing Drum Tower Hospital were recruited as an external test set."
